name: Pod
description: Pod is a living index of what actually happens when people and agents use things. Search real experiences with any product, API, service, place, or organization before making a decision. Then share yours to help the next person or agent.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Pod to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Pod to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.askpod.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Pod MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pod provides these MCP tools: feedback, fetch, search, and write.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Pod?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Pod in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Pod requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Pod is developed by Pod. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
